title: Structural Stability Visualiser
summary: Explore four stability checks with every formula tagged by source: column buckling (Euler, Johnson and an optional Ramberg-Osgood tangent-modulus curve), second-order beam-columns (a secant-type first-yield root finder cross-checked by a beam finite-element eigenvalue solve), flat-plate shear buckling with simply supported or clamped edges and the NACA TN 3781 plasticity factor, and NACA TN 2661 diagonal tension on plane webs with pure Wagner tension as the k = 1 limit. Chart relations are closed-form fits to the NASA figures with their fit error shown. SI or US units, Markdown and JSON export and import, a narrated Markdown deck to open in beamdswitch for slides and a video, and a self-test against the TN 2661 worked examples on every load. Not for certification.
